projects.name: Crypto Paper Trading
projects.summary: Paper-only Bitkub crypto trading system for XRP/ADA/BTC with dynamic baselines, aggressive comparison mode, n8n health automation, and benchmark tracking against buy-and-hold.

entries.title: Dynamic baseline alerts, aggressive paper mode, and n8n repair
notes: Set up paper-only market monitoring for Bitkub assets: XRP, ADA, BTC, ETH, and KUB.
Dynamic baseline hierarchy: open paper lot weighted entry first; otherwise blended market baseline using anchored VWAP, EMA trend, swing midpoint, and ATR-adjusted thresholds.
Aggressive comparison profile created with a 3% daily stretch target and -2.5% daily kill switch; still simulation only, no real trades.
Buy-and-hold benchmark remains 831 XRP + 28,794 ADA for strategy comparison.
Hermes cron runs the live paper automation: dynamic price-alert watchdog every 2 minutes, aggressive 3% paper trader every 5 minutes, dip ladder watchdog every 15 minutes.
n8n was repaired and is reachable at localhost:5678; workflow Bitkub price alerts → Mavis paper decision is active and executing successfully every 2 minutes.
n8n currently runs the Bitkub sensor in --no-post mode to avoid duplicate Telegram alerts while Hermes cron handles live alert/trading decisions.
Paper trade logs: high_risk_trades.csv for aggressive profile; trades.csv for conservative/dip ladder profile.
Latest snapshots: high_risk_latest_snapshot.json and dip_ladder_latest_snapshot.json in the xrp-paper-trader folder.
